title: Affine subspace indicator formula
statement: For a natural number $n$, let $H$ be a linear subspace of the vector space $(F_2)^n$, and let $a,x\in(F_2)^n$. The indicator of the affine subspace $a+H$ at $x$ equals $2^{-\operatorname{codim}(H)}$ times the sum, over all $\gamma$ perpendicular to $H$, of the character $y\mapsto(-1)^{\sum_{i=1}^n\gamma_i y_i}$ evaluated at $x+a$.
hypotheses_covered: $H$ is a linear subspace of $(\mathbf F_2)^n$
